title: Bistable vegetation-water model of the lower Tarim River
description: Two-state vegetation-water model with an Allee threshold depending on water stress and effective water supply, the MODIS-derived corridor tables for the lower Tarim River (2000-2023), and the scripts that reproduce every number and figure in the manuscript.
